name: Pista Kulfi (Indian Frozen Dessert with Pistachios)

instructions.primary_message: If using paper cups, ensure you have enough space in your freezer to accommodate a small baking sheet pan or tray. Arrange cups on a baking sheet or tray and set aside.
Place milk and saffron in a small bowl, then set aside to infuse for 10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp whole milk
1 pinch saffron threads

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, mince pistachios and set aside.

When the saffron is done infusing, place infused milk (and saffron threads) in a blender along with sweetened condensed milk, evaporated milk, cream, and cardamom. Blend on high until smooth, 1-2 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (397 g) can sweetened condensed milk
1 (340 g) can evaporated milk
¾ cup heavy whipping cream
½ tsp cardamom, ground

instructions.primary_message: If desired, add food coloring to the blender and blend once more until kulfi mixture is green. Add minced pistachios and pulse a few times to combine.
Divide kulfi mixture between the cups or popsicle molds.
Carefully place baking sheet in the freezer and chill until semi-set, about 2 hours.
Remove baking sheet from the freezer. Insert popsicle sticks into the center of the kulfi, then return to the freezer. Continue to freeze until fully set, 1 hour more.
Once set, remove kulfi from the freezer and rinse under hot water, from the tap, if necessary, to loosen and remove from their molds. Share and enjoy!
